name: Grid
summary: Equal columns for things compared side by side (options, variants), as many as fit at `size.column-min` each, a gutter apart; rows sit a group's space apart. Below two columns' width it becomes one column, so it never scrolls sideways from 320 px. Not for a page's regions (use LibraryLayout), a column of unrelated content (use Stack) or a wrapping row of small marks (use Cluster).
a11y: A plain `div` with no role: it arranges, it doesn't group for assistive technology. Reading order is the source order, row by row.

props.name: children
props.description: The things to compare, in reading order; each takes one column.

props.name: max
props.description: The most columns, even with room for more: 2 keeps four things 2 × 2 instead of 3 + 1. Default: as many as fit.
